english.title: Operate / hold self out as someone who may operate an aeronautical radio station
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[operated]_
(B)_[held yourself out as one who may operate]_

an aeronautical radio station for a purpose specified in article 202(4) of the Air Navigation Order 2016, namely **(..SPECIFY PURPOSE..), when you did not hold on 9th August 2012 an Air Ground Communication Service Radio Operator's Certificate of Competence or an Offshore Communication Service Radio Operator's Certificate of Competence issued by the CAA or hold and comply with the terms of an aeronautical radio station operator certificate of competence granted under 203 of the Order authorising you to provide such a service
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 202 and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
